integrity: All formulae arise from an explicit homotopy decomposition into star joins and two link-cone attachments. Finite computation is supplementary and not an infinite proof. No independent audit or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the bidirected double-star family with two adjacent hub vertices, each with at least one leaf; it does not treat all bidirected trees or equivariant actions. The direct finite checker covers parameter pairs through six leaves per hub and three finite fields, whereas the topology proof holds for all positive integer parameters. Nonindexed equivalent literature may exist.
title: Homotopy classification of bidirected double-star multipath complexes
